# Sourdough Starter — Maintenance Log

## Feeding schedule
Feed the starter once per day at room temperature, or once per week
when stored in the refrigerator. Ratio 1:1:1 (starter : flour : water).

## Recipe: basic country loaf
- 500g bread flour
- 350g water (70% hydration)
- 100g active starter (fed 4-6 hours prior, bubbly and floaty)
- 10g salt

## Method
1. Autolyse: mix flour and water, rest 1 hour.
2. Add starter, then salt. Four sets of stretch and folds, 30 min apart.
3. Bulk ferment 4-5 hours until 50% rise.
4. Shape, then cold retard in the fridge overnight.
5. Bake in Dutch oven at 250°C covered 20 min, uncovered 22 min.

## Notes
The kitchen runs cold in winter — bulk fermentation needs an extra
hour in January. The starter smells pleasantly acidic, like green apple.
